name: [UPD] Fly to Space for Brainrot 🚀
desc:
Welcome to Jetpack to Space for Brainrots!

How To Play:
🚀 Use your Jetpack to fly to SPACE!
🚨 Escape the guards chasing you 
😂 Collect Brainrots from the platforms you reach
🍀 The higher you go, the better Brainrots you can find!
💸 Your Brainrots generate money over time
⛽ Use your cash to buy more fuel and keep flying

💤 Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE!
